scientific_claim: Best performance found within the predefined retrospective search, not global optimality or independent confirmation

parallelism.forecast_limit_reason: Bound peak shared storage independently of training concurrency

representations.gene_axis: Retained annotation-defined ordered 18129 RNA features, excluding technical PuroR; not a new expression-selected axis
representations.architecture: Count-native 18129-512-128-48 encoder and mirrored full-gene decoder with LayerNorm/GELU
representations.weights: Fresh subset-specific initialization; no all-four or historical trained-weight initialization
representations.center_scale_and_technical_holdout: Fit only on the exact training subset
representations.historical_R48_reuse: Architecture and tested preprocessing principles only; historical Rest/Stim48hr fitting is not this observation schedule

objective_lineage.state_training_base: Actual retained debiased Sinkhorn, not the energy assessment statistic
objective_lineage.count_estimator: One full-catalog normalizer per donor, current active laws plus detached inactive cache, sampling-scaled active gradient, equal-donor reduction
objective_lineage.microbatch_rule: One logical-batch active replacement and normalizer; never separately normalize each microbatch catalog
objective_lineage.count_cache_refresh_schedule: Must be bound to accepted update indices before launch; historical epoch cadence is not silently inherited
objective_lineage.new_method_regularization: Explicit per-family terms; no claim that all families isolate one mechanism

selector_policy.later_incumbent: That selector's chosen F0 family configuration, uncalibrated at the same current update prefix
selector_policy.incumbent_reason: Retain one F0 family winner without silently adding an extra continuing baseline trajectory
selector_policy.quality: 0.5 * mean(all allowed donor-channel normalized risks) + 0.5 * maximum(all allowed donor-channel normalized risks)
selector_policy.missing_required_channels: Unavailable selection; never zero-fill or silently remove a channel
selector_policy.numerical_nonnegative_risks: Score in FP64; preserve raw risk and64-epsilon*max(1,sum_absolute_components) bound; only negative roundoff within that bound reports zero; larger negative values fail. Training losses remain unclipped.
selector_policy.near_zero_ratio_fallback: Allocation arithmetic uses fitting-scale absolute fallback; fallback cells cannot be called a literal percentage improvement for the5percent/2percent advancement rule
selector_policy.latent_comparisons: Normalize against the matched incumbent inside each subset-native representation
selector_policy.candidate_eligibility: Frozen separately per outer selector; another selector's continuation never adds an eligible candidate
selector_policy.outer_outcome_use: Assessment only after that selector's recipes, calibrations and complete forecasts are sealed

ensemble.rule: Equal mixture of the three calibrated finite measures, not coordinate averaging
ensemble.prefix_rule: Recompute proposal corrections, integrals and complete catalog frequencies at each component prefix; reuse generated state prefixes
ensemble.mixture_importance_correction: For four balanced proposal components with n_k particles, P*pi_k/n_k; includes nondivisible seed budgets

storage_plan.required_implementation: Bounded retention, forecast commitment and qualified exact replay, plus aggregate reservations before admission
storage_plan.status: Sizing proposal; actual bank layouts, readback and aggregate capacity release remain required

open_launch_bindings: Exact live native input publication and per-fold row identities
Observation training/technical holdout/selection and preprocessing integration
Per-family enabled auxiliary losses, fitting-only scales and regularization
Pooled-NTC companion, support and reduction rules
Update-based count-cache schedule and logical-batch gradient implementation
Forecast/calibration/reliability/readout operation counts and storage retention
Same-source H100 numerical, restart, memory and throughput qualification
Durable four-worker ownership and actual scheduler/mount admission
